verdicts.title: Syzygy of Thoughts: Improving LLM CoT with the Minimal Free Resolution
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting enhances the reasoning of large language models (LLMs) by decomposing problems into sequential steps, mimicking human logic and reducing errors. However, complex tasks with vast solution spaces and vague constraints often exceed the capacity of a single reasoning chain.
